title: Apple reportedly lays off Vision employees amid shifting priorities - 9to5Mac
summary: According to the report , which cites reliable sources, “Apple has laid off at least 60 employees tied to Apple’s VR team, the Apple Vision Group, and similar positions.” Apple has not confirmed nor commented on the report.
